name: mission-apimpossible
description: Call a governed Azure OpenAI Responses endpoint using your own Microsoft Entra identity.

missionApimpossible.endpoint.markdownDescription:
Gateway Responses endpoint, e.g. `https://apim-map-xyz.azure-api.net/openai/v1/responses`.

**Application scope is deliberate.** A workspace-scoped endpoint would let a cloned repository silently redirect your access token to an attacker-controlled host.

missionApimpossible.model.description: Approved deployment name. The gateway rejects any other value.

missionApimpossible.tenantId.description: Entra tenant GUID. Token acquisition is pinned to this tenant.

missionApimpossible.scope.description: OAuth scope for the Foundry audience. Must produce a token whose 'aud' matches what the gateway accepts.

missionApimpossible.maxOutputTokens.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per request.
